messages:
Leah (People Ops): Morning all ":wave:" pushed a consolidated handbook update: 'PTO Harmonization & Emergency Acks'. Goal: align US/EU/APAC notice windows, add manager audit flow, and a simple manager ack + training rollout. Need quick ops signoff and a rollout schedule.

Omar (Hiring Ops): Looks good at a glance. For rollout do we want manager-only acks or manager+team? I vote manager-only for tracking.

Leah (People Ops): Manager-only. Two waves: Wave 1 = managers with >8 directs or budget approvers, Wave 2 = remaining managers. Target: 8 business days. Reminder cadence: day 0, day 3, day 6. If Wave 1 < 70% by day 5 escalate to org leads.

Nora (HR-Intl): Heads-up: several APAC countries have statutory notice requirements for extended PTO — I added a short per-country table and a template email managers can use. Also added a religious-accommodation FAQ so managers know how to handle scheduling conflicts. Link: https://notion.redwood/handbook/pto-harmonize

Dex (Eng Manager): Two quick Qs: 1) contractors—are they in scope? 2) retro-pay / backpay for approved emergency PTO? We had an odd case last month for cross-border payroll.

Leah (People Ops): Contractors: out of scope for paid PTO but we added a contractor guidance snippet and a Hiring Ops template to request discretionary contractor coverage. Retro-pay: allowed for employees only, within 21 days of incident, requires manager + People Ops signoff and payroll ticket. Added examples and a short doc upload checklist.

Omar (Hiring Ops): I'll export manager list and attach a CSV to People Ops drive. I can param manager_id in the ack link so the landing page preloads their directs and team size. Will webhook ack events to the People Ops tracker sheet to avoid manual spreadsheets.

ack-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Handbook: PTO Harmonization  Manager ack due in 8d"  sending Wave 1 in 10 minutes.

Leah (People Ops): Training plan: 18-min recorded briefing + 7-question quick quiz. Localized recordings for EMEA/APAC (Nora will record). Require managers to watch and attest; then mark in the ack form that they discussed the policy with their team in the next 1:1.

Nora (HR-Intl): Will record at 09:00 & 17:00 CET next Tue and upload captions. I'll also produce FR/DE/JA one-page summaries highlighting local statutory differences.

Dex (Eng Manager): Can the ack flow include a short field for edge cases? For example, we sometimes need to grant an exception for customer-facing on-call rotations.

Leah (People Ops): Yes — adding an "exception reason" free-text field and a checkbox that routes to People Ops review. Exceptions auto-create a support ticket to People Ops and Payroll if retro-pay is checked.

Omar (Hiring Ops): I'll include a contractor flag in the export so Hiring Ops can filter and not include contractors in the manager ack waves by mistake. Also will add manager_email param for the tokenized link.

Leah (People Ops): Manager checklist snippet going into the handbook (short):

``
Manager checklist:
- Review per-country notes for your directs
- Collect documentation for emergency PTO (email/itinerary/brief statement)
- Submit retro-pay request within 21 days if applicable
- Complete handbook ack + training in 8 business days
- Mark team discussion done in next 1:1 or forward to People Ops for escalation
```

Dex (Eng Manager): Thanks. I'll DM two recent edge cases (one on-call overlap, one cross-border payroll) by EOD.

Leah (People Ops): Final action items: Nora finalizes localized notes & recordings by EOD Mon, Omar runs exports + schedules reminders today, Dex share edge cases. I will publish company-wide notice after Wave 1 hits 65% ack. Thanks :thumbsup:
